data.design: A dark spherical face suspended inside purple gas, with large eyes and visible fangs. The suspended face and gas distinguish it from the more solid, masked and clothlike ghosts sharing its habitats. Use the existing stock silhouette and animation; the haunted region introduces no new regional form.

moves.description: Uses the Ghost form of Curse: the user sacrifices HP to place recurring damage on the target.
moves.name: Curse

moves.description: A Ghost attack strengthened when the target has a status problem.
